usedFor: Slack carries the emails and phone numbers people paste in, and ApexVerify checks whether they are good. A “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack can run “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: One address per message maps to one check, and you choose the verification type and country. “Create Verification Batch” suits lists, but it only uploads a batch and prepares it.

watchOut: “New Thread Message” is polling, so a thread reply is checked on a schedule. The channel trigger also includes bot messages, so your own bot's posts can be sent to “Verify Email or Phone” too.
